profile.headline: Software Engineer II | Security+
profile.summary: Jimara Thomas-Rowden is a results-driven Software Engineer with extensive experience in vulnerability management, risk assessment, and network automation. Strong expertise in threat analysis, secure coding, automation, and compliance. Holds CompTIA Security+ certification, with hands-on experience in scripting, network security, and cloud security. Passionate about leveraging automation and security best practices to protect systems and data.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Network Engineer, 02/2024-Present
•	Maintain, monitor, and optimize network infrastructure to ensure reliable performance and up time.
•	Analyze, troubleshoot, and improve complex systems and networks to enhance functionality & resolve issues. 
•	Manage and remediate vulnerabilities within Layer 2 and Layer 3 switches, access points, and wireless controllers. 
•	Drove asset management initiatives to catalog and organize all network devices within the infrastructure, integrating data from multiple sources. 
•	Developed Power BI dashboards to identify data inconsistencies, manage resources and streamline the data validation process. 
•	Administered a network troubleshooting tool, overseeing user access, updating inventory lists, and improving device search capabilities, and command execution
•	Designed, implemented and documented automation solutions utilizing Python scripts and CI/CD pipelines to remove unused subnets, switch configuration and decommissioning, device upgrades, and network troubleshooting.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
A two-year rotational program designed for recent graduates, offering networking opportunities, training, and mentorship to kickstart careers in IT. Participants engage in real-world challenges, receive ongoing training, and collaborate with global leaders through networking sessions. The program also includes volunteering, stretch projects, team-building activities, and continuous mentorship.

Cybersecurity Engineer, 08/2021-02/2024
•	Managed and remediated non-operating system vulnerabilities within applications on Windows and Linux servers. 
•	Deployed patches, updated software, and removed deprecated software to address vulnerabilities. 
•	Provided guidance to users on improving their vulnerability scores through the ServiceNow Request and Change Management System. 
•	Troubleshot issues related to patch deployments and vulnerability remediation, utilizing scanning tools.
•	Automated vulnerability remediation processes using scripting languages such as PowerShell, Java, Python, Bash. 
•	Conducted mass remediation efforts via Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) and BBSA. 
•	Documented remediation processes and solutions in Confluence and SharePoint to help users understand applied fixes. 
•	Utilized Microsoft Excel for data analysis, identifying and verifying non-operating system vulnerabilities, using pivot tables and troubleshooting skills
